alias_rule: case- plus first 20 hex characters of SHA256(seed + newline + 'alias' + newline + private_identity)
analysis: Report verdict counts, abstentions, pairwise disagreement, mechanical disagreement, and control failures separately.
AI agreement is not truth and is not independent human annotation.
Same-family models can share errors. Record actual model identity, tools, prompts, and independence limits.
Public Click source may have appeared in training. Blinding does not establish absence of benchmark leakage.
Repeated modules and parent groups are correlated. Report unique source hashes and group-level results, without treating 36 rows as independent evidence.
This small pilot cannot establish a population error rate or validate replacement of human semantic annotation.
authentic_reference_answers: Not computed during preparation. No CAMI validator or oracle is run.

decision_rules.comparison: Keep both AI decisions and the mechanical decision. Never replace disagreement with an AI majority.
decision_rules.contradicted: Independent mechanical evidence establishes absence or signature mismatch, with no uncertainty rule triggered.
decision_rules.controls: All nine clear negative controls must be contradicted. All three duplicate controls must be uncertain. Any different result blocks expansion and is reported.
decision_rules.exclusions: Keep all 36 cases in the denominator. Record excluded or uncertain cases and reasons. No replacements, post-outcome sampling, or assertion repair.
decision_rules.failure: Fail closed on reviewer disagreement, mechanical disagreement, unexpected controls, missing decisions, hash mismatch, or evidence outside the packet.
decision_rules.supported: Independent mechanical evidence confirms the exact supplied syntactic predicate under the rubric.
decision_rules.uncertain: Any stated ambiguity, unsupported construct, missing evidence, or unresolved conflict.

duplicate_control_choice: First symbol_exists claim in each selected group by original claim_id, with two duplicate subject definitions appended
freeze_and_scope: Root records the exact protocol and packet hashes before reviewers run. Any later change creates a new proposal and is disclosed.
Only the public packet is provided to fresh reviewers. Private files remain with the coordinator.
No child sources, child outcomes, held-out repository cases, policy runs, or main evaluation are accessed.
This exploratory pilot permits AI review records and research reports only; it creates no CAMI labels, receipts, admission or main evaluation changes.
Controls are authored development cases and must never enter real labels or be described as unchanged Git parent snapshots.

mechanical_reference.abstention: Duplicate, conditional, target rebinding, generic type parameters, source or parse limitation, or unresolved ambiguity gives uncertain.
mechanical_reference.evidence: Record Python version, implementation hash, source hashes, extracted facts, and line evidence before comparison with AI answers.
mechanical_reference.implementation: A separate implementation must derive facts from packet source bytes using CPython ast. It must not import cami, copy CAMI extraction code, or use CAMI results.
mechanical_reference.shared_dependency: CPython ast is shared infrastructure. Implementation independence does not imply parser independence.
mechanical_reference.status: Implementation authored blind to pilot sources; frozen before execution.
mechanical_reference.syntax_contract: All fields of supplied expected_signature, including AST expression syntax, decorators, and async. No runtime signature inference.
coverage_limits: Complete explicit signature fields required; omitted/defaulted fields abstain.
Class-body global declaration of target conservatively abstains.

nonexistent_control_choice: First symbol_exists claim in each selected group by original claim_id
order_rule: Ascending SHA256(seed + newline + 'order' + newline + public_id), then public_id
reviewer_blinding: Fresh separate contexts. No CAMI code, prior review, mechanical answers, private map, original candidate identities, or source origins.
scope: Exploratory development Click parent-only annotation-method pilot
selection: Three lowest SHA256(seed + newline + group_id) ranks among development Click groups. All eight structural claims in each group.
signature_control_choice: First two signature_equals claims in each selected group by original claim_id
record_format: Strict schema and scripts/validate_ai_review.py; methodology sidecar records tools and parser.
pre_freeze_integration: Output-format conflict between staged rubric and harness resolved to strict schema before any review; no case/source/predicate changed.
